lines: My heart says it doesn't want to forget.
I want to stay by your side forever.
Is it okay if I'm a crybaby?
You don't have to pretend to be strong.
Even if our love is finite.
To have met you is happiness.
Even if I can't take your hand.
I say I don't want to wake up.
I want to be by your side tomorrow too.
I want you to scold my insensitivity.
I'm still a child who can't even notice.
I wish my time could stop.
See, I end up hoping again.
I'll try to hold it in tightly.
Look properly into my eyes, look, look.
Even if I can't take your hand.
I am embraced by the passing present.
I wish my time could stop.
